title: FW↔DEVOPS-001: OTA Firmware/Model Distribution + Signing
description: DevOps delivers OTA distribution bundles (firmware and model artifacts) with signing; Firmware verifies the signature chain, compatibility manifest, flash budget, and SHA-256, then reports verification status. Grounded in FIRMWARE_ENGINEER_SKILL §6.4 (Model Artifact OTA Coordination) and §6.6 (signed images).

bundle_type.description: Whether the bundle carries a firmware image or a model artifact.

target_hardware_id.description: Hardware ID the bundle targets; firmware verifies it matches the device.

image_format.description: MCUboot-compatible binary layout (per FW↔MLOPS artifact-format contract).

sha256_hash.description: SHA-256 of the bundle payload; must match the manifest.

signatures.description: Signature chain. Firmware verifies DevOps co-signature and (for model artifacts) the MLOps signature.

flash_budget_check_passed.description: DevOps-asserted flash-budget fit; firmware re-verifies on-device.

verification_report.description: Returned by Firmware within 1 minute of download completion.

x-macp.tier_rationale: OTA distribution + image signing — security-baseline + OTA-strategy surface (permanent HITL gate; SEC veto applies via HG-01).
x-macp.cadence: TRIGGER (CI integration at development start); SLA_FROM_EVENT (firmware reports VERIFIED/VERIFICATION_FAILED within 1 minute of download)
confirm_conditions: devops_cosignature valid; for MODEL_ARTIFACT, mlops_signature also valid
target_hardware_id matches the device and firmware version is in-range (not excluded)
image_format = MCUBOOT and A/B partition + rollback path available
reject_conditions: any signature in the chain invalid (ESC-SEC)
device firmware version is in excluded_versions
counter_conditions: maximum_version null but device firmware is far newer than tested range — request compatibility confirmation
signature_algorithm differs from device-provisioned key policy — request key/algo reconciliation (do not weaken baseline)
